reviewScope: Independent static review of SPEC, five UI/usage diffs, NumUnitText and original PNG drawing; personal viewing of all 56 Georgian original state screenshots and actual downloaded PNG; Armenian two-image regression sample. No product or test execution by reviewer.

visualCoverage.imageProcessing: None; viewed original files with view_image, no crop/redraw/transformation

findings: Free initial cart disclosure and normal 200F/200W/100G/200S, 4/5 population are consistent across the initial states.
Paid cart details show 20 food and 80 wood; cart quantity uses 辆 and numerical-unit fragments do not visibly split.
Compound block retains 25 wood primary House cost while separate cart note discloses 80 wood/20 food; no whole-step total is invented.
Timeline, share preview, practice and print retain free-start and paid-explicit-action policy plus fixed walking/no movement/no automatic reuse limits.
Bonus0 describes the implemented cart policy without claiming Church aura or military effects are calculated.
Actual 1080x1350 PNG has complete, readable two-note disclosure with no clipped new fee/policy text.
Armenian sampled 360 light paid-cart detail remains 15 food/60 wood; its actual PNG retains existing research enhancement note.
executionInterpretation: Initial execution actually 12 passed and 6 mobile Georgian timed out at hidden desktop #tlciv locator; test-only recovery opens the real mobile Settings entry, keeps assertions and product unchanged, and passed the six affected cases. Combined coverage is 18 distinct scenarios, not a single green 18-case run.
testOnlyRecoveryStaticReview: Read exact diff: branch by actual #tlciv visibility, open Settings on mobile, use its picker, assert picker closes and close Settings via existing Done button. No assertion/timeout/retry weakening.
visualLimitations: Existing shared 跳到主内容 floating link is visible in print screenshots: near step 12 at desktop and step 2/3 at mobile. This review does not claim every print pixel is unobscured.

Some full-page captures taken after scrolling include the fixed global header and focused skip link in the middle of the captured page. This review makes a bounded new-content layout/policy verdict rather than asserting no shared overlay anywhere.

The reviewer did not run the browser, test runner, build or domain; assertions such as console/pageerror absence and overflow/axe checks are evidenced by actual owner reports, while visual conclusions come from the original images.
